payload.text: The rollout began on 2026-11-15, when hv seated hello by hand (ISSUE:0008; vc's brief of 2026-11-16). From now on hv alone runs ccusage use, ccusage login and ccusage which --use, on vc's steps; no seat runs them, and no build of cc's runs against the real XDG config or reads a real Keychain item.
